summary: Phase 1 review of packages/db and packages/domain identified 3 High-severity findings: 9 tables from primary.ts are unclassified in the tenant registry, the referential-scoping static check in tenant-coverage.test.ts is vacuous, and declared drizzle-orm versions are inconsistent across packages. Lint and type checks pass; db/domain tests fail due to these findings.

findings.title: Tenant registry missing 9 tables from primary.ts
findings.evidence: tenant-coverage.test.ts fails: verificationTokens, userRoles, roles, articleActivityLogs, sentencsAndWordsForFlashcards, cardReviews, clozeTestGames, schoolAdmins, leaderboards are unclassified

findings.title: Referential scoping static check is vacuous
findings.evidence: hasBareTenantDbOnReferential() unconditionally returns false; proven with temporary fixture that queries articles through createTenantDB and still passes the domain-code tenant coverage check

findings.title: Inconsistent drizzle-orm declarations across workspace
findings.evidence: Declared versions: db ^0.45.0, domain 0.44.7, auth ^0.44.0, api ^0.44.0; root has no pnpm.overrides; drizzle045-* tests fail

findings.title: Missing migration sentinel probes for 0022 and 0023
findings.evidence: journal-integrity.test.ts fails: 0022_flowery_black_tarantula, 0023_cultured_sunspot have no sentinel probes

findings.title: Table name typo: sentencsAndWordsForFlashcards / sentencs_and_words_for_flashcard
findings.evidence: TypeScript export and DB table use 'sentencs' instead of 'sentences'

findings.title: Wide reshape migration 0013 has high blast radius

PROJECT_LINT.details: Ran directly per package: db 8 warnings/0 errors, domain 11 warnings/0 errors
